title: Citation Link-Rot Last-Success Ledger
description: Per-URL last-successful-check ledger persisted to actions/cache (never committed to the repo). Optimization only — never a source of truth. A cache miss means 'check everything', never 'assume healthy'.

last_ok.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent 2xx-final outcome. ONLY written on a 2xx-final result; a 4xx never refreshes this.

last_status.description: Most recent observed final HTTP status. Enables 'previously healthy on <date>' context in the tracking issue.
